How much do I have to pay to get my Scholarship? For the service fee, generally speaking, SICAS will only charge you 10% of the 4 or 3 years of total scholarship amount (there could be a bit difference according to the exact Type of Scholarship that you choose). However, in the beginning , only $300 to $400 need to be paid as a minimum service fee and $75 as application fee to the university at first. When SICAS help you successfully get the scholarship,then the price difference need to be paid. For example: If you get the Undergraduate C Level of Shandong Jiaotong University, The total cost will be: RMB 9000x 4years x 10% =RMB 3600 = USD 600. and since you have paid USD 400, then the price difference: USD 600 - USD 400 = USD 200 need to be paid. Scholarship Guaranteed ? Yes. -After you paid the Scholarship Service Fee as above table listed, SICAS will guarantee you the scholarship! Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. Objectives The graduate program in Mechanical Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of mechanical engineering. Students are expected to engage in scientific research, and to assume leadership role in the mechanical industries. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5-2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Design and Manufacturing 2. Mechatronics and Automation 3. Fluid and Heat Transfer Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 27 credits units. Of the 27 credits units required, 12 must be core courses, 10 must be elective courses, 3 must be experimental and thematic courses, and 2 must be practical courses.
